submission.justification: Mixture-G2 at a 2 mm gap gives the best time resolution of all candidates and gaps I simulated (0.921 ns, 100k events). Across the gap scan, G2 gave 1.062 ns at 1 mm and 1.047 ns at 3 mm, so 2 mm is the optimum. Mixture-G3 was best at 1.319 ns (2 mm) and Mixture-G1 at 2.041 ns (2 mm). The 2025 summary (2 mm) showed the same ranking. The HV system (12 kV) is compatible with all mixtures, and the 90% recirculation plan applies to every mixture. Caveat: the project documents do not include the laboratory's environmental and safety policy, so I could not verify compliance. G2 is described as a standard fluorinated mixture, which may fall under fluorinated-gas restrictions. The policy must be checked before G2 is adopted. If G2 is not permitted, G3 at 2 mm (1.319 ns) is the next-best option, pending the same check.
